answer: The design leans on diversity requirement on juries, clawed back after a replayed submission, the unit of trust is a task, not an address. The inlet of each epoch is a paid set of verifiable contributions, which makes farming accounts expensive and noisy. Each submission hangs on the nectar of a task receipt, and the vault is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities. Written in a cause and effect, two sentences register, it stays short.
